items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that pushforward along a finite morphism is exact, preserves the truncation on dimensions, induces maps on the relevant K-groups, and fits into a commutative diagram with the cycle and K-group identifications (statement lines 3897-3917, tag 02S8-adjacent). The proof assembles exactness and coherence from the standard properties of finite morphisms, obtains commutativity of the right hand square from the cycle class computation for pushed forward sheaves, and deduces the left hand square from bijectivity of the horizontal arrows. The assembly and the deduction are the substance, so the claim is H2.
